TI.P: Corrigendum to Directive (EU) 2025/2450 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 26 November 2025 amending Directive 2009/38/EC as regards the establishment and operation of European Works Councils and the effective enforcement of transnational information and consultation rights
(Official Journal of the European Union L, 2025/2450, 11 December 2025)
